messages:
sophie: Quick follow-up from the rate-limit / KV-eviction postmortem — planning a 2-week remediation sprint to turn the actions into tests. Need owners for three lanes: regression promptset (token blowups), load scenario (sustained traffic replay), and chaos drill (KV eviction + model-fallback). Sprint starts Mon.

alex: I can take the regression promptset. Will draft initial promptset & add to evals repo. ETA Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: I can own the load scenario. Need to pair with infra for a realistic runner and a CI job. Will draft traffic profile by Tue. cc @dylan

jordan: I’ll own the chaos drill plan and the runbook. Suggest we run the first drill on staging with a small canary. I can run it next Fri and iterate.

dylan: infra can carve out a temporary 2-node job for the load test. Maria, send the exact traffic profile and retention requirements. Example command we can use for load:
```
k6 run --vus 3000 --duration 30m script.js --out influxdb
```

sophie: Action summary (sprint owners & due dates):
- alex: regression promptset + expected pass/fail criteria — Wed EOD
- maria: load profile + infra reqs — Tue noon
- jordan: chaos drill doc + checklist — Thu EOD
- dylan: infra carve + CI job — Wed EOD
I’ll add these as cards on the postmortem board and set reminders. Please add PR/links to the cards when you have them.

alex: Noted. I’ll include sample prompts that triggered token blowups and clear acceptance: latency P95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% for the replayed window.

maria: Quick question — do we want recorded replay of the incident traces or synthetic traffic? Replay gives fidelity but we may need sanitization.

sophie: Replay preferred for fidelity; if sanitization is a blocker, fall back to synthetic with realistic token-size and session timing distributions.

deploy-bot: New card created: "PMT: rate-limit -> tests" assigned to sophie — https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/123 (automated)

jordan: Also propose a regression gate: if KV eviction incidence > 0.1% over 24h or model fallback rate > 0.5%, auto-fail the rollout and trigger oncall paging. We should codify that in the gating doc.

alex: I’ll add the gate and expected metrics to the evals gating doc and PR it to the pipeline.

sophie: Sprint cadence & check-ins: Mon/Wed/Fri 11:00am standup (15m). Two-week retro at the end. If anything slips, update the board and ping me. :heart:

maria: Sounds good — I’ll post the first draft of the load profile tomorrow and include replay samples if available.

jordan: Will add runbook snippets and a checklist for safe staging drills (traffic cutover, monitoring knobs, rollback steps).

sophie: Closing the loop here — owners assigned, initial timelines set, and cards created. I’ll follow up with calendar invites and reminders. Ping me for blockers or if you need incident traces access.
